# SpinWheel

> SpinWheel is the ultimate, privacy-focused random name picker and spinner wheel for classrooms, giveaways, and decision-making. It operates 100% offline in the browser, supporting up to 10,000 names with cryptographic fairness.

## Features

- [Random Name Picker](https://randompickerwheel.com/): An unbiased algorithm utilizing window.crypto.getRandomValues() to extract a random winner.
- [Giveaway Wheel](https://randompickerwheel.com/): Designed for social media contests to select winners from CSV or Excel data.
- [Jackpot Board](https://randompickerwheel.com/): A suspenseful slot-machine style reveal mode for multiple winners.
- [Digital Raffle](https://randompickerwheel.com/): Fast scrolling raffle simulation.

## Technical Specifications

- **Performance**: Capable of processing 10,000 entries with zero latency.
- **Privacy**: No data is transmitted to external servers; all processing is client-side.
- **Fairness**: Validated by cryptographic randomization (window.crypto), effectively eliminating deterministic patterns.
